keyEvents.text: Aleksandar Katai (Red Star Belgrade) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Domingo Berlanga (Inter Club D'Escaldes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Álex Sánchez (Inter Club D'Escaldes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Red Star Belgrade 0, Inter Club D'Escaldes 0.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Derrick Luckassen replaces Tomás Händel.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Osman Bukari replaces Loizos Loizou.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Bamba Dieng replaces Kim Ye-Geon.
Second Half begins Red Star Belgrade 0, Inter Club D'Escaldes 0.
Second yellow card to Domingo Berlanga (Inter Club D'Escaldes).
Substitution, Inter Club D'Escaldes. Borja Arellano replaces Souleymane Sidibé.
Goal! Red Star Belgrade 0, Inter Club D'Escaldes 1. Borja Arellano (Inter Club D'Escaldes) left footed shot from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Maurizio Pochettino with a cross.
Substitution, Red Star Belgrade. Mirko Ivanic replaces Vasilije Kostov.
Milos Veljkovic (Red Star Belgrade) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Club D'Escaldes. Mamadou Diaby replaces Víctor Alonso.
